source: SAMPLE DATA — general alignment with the MEXT 2023 Revised Guideline on Responding to Research Misconduct, NOT sourced from cited primary-document sections or page references. Not verified against the primary source. Must be replaced with an institution-verified, citation-backed policy KB (see docs/07_operation_guide.md 'Knowledge Base Setup') before production use.
institution_scope_note: This range reflects unverified MEXT-2023-aligned sample ranges only. Institution-specific application is the responsibility of the academic integrity officer.

ranges.fabrication:minor: Written warning; mandatory research ethics retraining.
ranges.fabrication:moderate: Suspension of research privileges (1-6 months); retraction of affected work.
ranges.fabrication:severe: Suspension or expulsion; retraction of affected work; referral for funding-body reporting.
ranges.falsification:minor: Written warning; correction of affected records.
ranges.falsification:moderate: Suspension of research privileges (1-6 months); retraction of affected work.
ranges.falsification:severe: Suspension or expulsion; retraction of affected work; referral for funding-body reporting.
ranges.plagiarism:moderate: Grade nullification or course failure; suspension (1-3 months) for repeat cases.
ranges.plagiarism:severe: Suspension or expulsion; retraction of affected work.
ranges.other:minor: Written warning; case-specific corrective action per institutional policy.
ranges.other:moderate: Formal reprimand; case-specific corrective action per institutional policy.
ranges.other:severe: Suspension or expulsion; case-specific corrective action per institutional policy.
